description: This file contains classes and functions to handle reading and writing checkpoints in the HuggingFace safetensors format within a distributed training framework. It defines the HuggingFaceStorageWriter and HuggingFaceStorageReader classes to facilitate serialization and deserialization of model tensors, supporting sharding, consolidation, and parallel I/O.

classes.name: HuggingFaceStorageWriter
classes.description: A specialized file system writer for saving model shards and tensors in the HuggingFace safetensors format, supporting sharding, distributed saving, and checkpoint consolidation.

classes.name: HuggingFaceStorageReader
classes.description: A specialized file system reader for loading model tensors and metadata from safetensors files created in the HuggingFace format, with support for parallel reading.

methods.name: list[SavePlan] prepare_global_plan(self, plans: list[SavePlan])
methods.description: Prepares a save plan with additional metadata, including tensor-to-file mappings and shard indices.

methods.name: Future[list[WriteResult]] write_data( self, plan: SavePlan, planner: SavePlanner, )
methods.description: Performs the actual data writing of tensors to files based on the save plan and storage plan.

methods.name: None finish(self, metadata: Metadata, results: list[list[WriteResult]])
methods.description: Finalizes the writing process, performing checkpoint consolidation if needed, or writing metadata files.

methods.name: dict[int,list[WriteItem]] _split_by_storage_plan( self, storage_plan: dict[str, int] | None, items: list[WriteItem] )
methods.description: Splits write items into buckets according to storage plan indices for sharded saving.

methods.name: Metadata read_metadata(self)
methods.description: Reads and constructs metadata from safetensor files, including tensor shapes, dtypes, and offsets, handling sharding metadata if present.

methods.name: None _process_read_request(self, f, req: ReadItem, planner: LoadPlanner)
methods.description: Processes a single tensor read request from a safetensor file, copying data into the target tensor.

methods.name: None _read_files_from_queue( self, file_queue: queue.Queue, result_queue: queue.Queue, planner: LoadPlanner, )
methods.description: Worker function for parallel reading of multiple safetensor files.

methods.name: Future[None] read_data(self, plan: LoadPlan, planner: LoadPlanner)
methods.description: Performs the loading of tensors as specified in the load plan, supporting parallel I/O.
